name: Claw pick
summary: A claw machine full of plush food, each plush as big as the number of friends who pushed for it; steer the claw, drop it, and whatever lands in the chute is dinner.
useWhen: endless 'idk where do u wanna eat' and someone needs to just pick
a few places floated in the chat, some with fans, one vetoed: 'not rook's again'
dontUseWhen: one place already agreed (use an event)
a fair vote is wanted (use a poll or after-vote)
picking a person, not a place (use decider-potato)

params.title: string
params.sub: the chat's own line, lit up on the marquee, e.g. we're gonna eat today
params.prizes: 2-6 x {label, kind, voters: names who pushed for it in the chat, glued: veto line 'words · Name' or ''}. kind: the food this place is known for; pick the closest of dumpling|taco|burrito|ramen|pizza|burger|sandwich|sushi|onigiri|noodles|curry|chicken|salad|bagel|icecream|boba|fries|hotdog; use mystery when unsure
params.tried: {name, slipped: prize label} a drop that already slipped, or empty
